source.name: Passing through a prefilled datepicker must not change the date the form submits
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43149) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Leave the saved departure date untouched and change the passengers
journey.goal: Moving through the date field without picking a date leaves the submitted departure date unchanged

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker reformats the input value to a locale-specific date string when losing focus (e.g., after pressing Escape and tabbing away) because _syncSelectedDates unconditionally updates the input with the formatted date, even when no user date selection occurred.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a private flag _isUserSelected that is set to true only when a date is chosen via the calendar or when setSelectedDates is called programmatically. In _syncSelectedDates, update the input element's value only if the flag is true, preserving the original ISO format on initialization and focus loss.

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: No adverse impact on keyboard navigation or screen‑reader announcements; the date field retains its announced value, preventing confusing date format changes for assistive technology users.
functional_risks: External code that depends on the input value being updated to the locale format on focus loss may see unchanged values.
If other components expect the formatted value after the datepicker loses focus, they will receive the ISO string instead.
verification_requirements: After completing the journey, the submitted departure date must equal '2026-10-22'.
On page load, the departure input's value must be '2026-10-22'.
Choosing a date via the calendar updates the input with the locale‑formatted date (e.g., '10/22/2026' for en‑US).
Calling setSelectedDates with a date updates the input with the locale‑formatted date.
Pressing Escape and then tabbing away from the date field leaves the input value unchanged.
